item_short_desc: Rothco’s 3 Watt Cree Flashlight is the perfect tool for reliable and versatile illumination. Designed to deliver up to 150 lumens of bright light, this flashlight offers both low and high light modes, allowing you to adjust the brightness to suit your needs. For added functionality, the flashlight features a strobe mode, making it useful for defense or light signaling purposes. The zoom feature lets you switch between focused and wide illumination, giving you control over the beam's intensity and spread.
description: Rothco’s 3 Watt Cree Flashlight is the perfect tool for reliable and versatile illumination. Designed to deliver up to 150 lumens of bright light, this flashlight offers both low and high light modes, allowing you to adjust the brightness to suit your needs. For added functionality, the flashlight features a strobe mode, making it useful for defense or light signaling purposes. The zoom feature lets you switch between focused and wide illumination, giving you control over the beam's intensity and spread. Constructed from lightweight yet durable aluminum alloy, this flashlight is built to withstand everyday use. It comes with a lanyard and a pocket clip for seamless everyday carry, ensuring that you always have it at hand. The flashlight measures 5.25 inches in length and requires 3 AAA batteries (not included) to operate. Whether you’re exploring the outdoors, working on a project, or needing an emergency light source, Rothco’s 3 Watt Cree Flashlight is a dependable companion.
